root_cause: The timeout was caused by the 'getAllProgress' endpoint fetching all 'AttendanceRecord' documents from the database, performing deep populate operations on each, and aggregating the data entirely in Node.js memory. This approach failed under the load of the production dataset (2,117+ students).
aggregation_strategy: Replaced the in-memory array manipulation with a MongoDB Aggregation Pipeline ($group by studentId -> $sum for present/absent/total -> $lookup for student/branch details). Used $match for filtering (branch, year) and searching (name, rollNo) directly in the database.
pagination_implementation: Implemented standard offset-based pagination in the backend using $skip and $limit aggregation stages. Added page, limit, total, and totalPages to the response. Updated the frontend to track page/limit state and render Previous/Next navigation controls.
search_filter_implementation: Added search input (Roll Number / Name) and dropdown filters (Branch, Year) to the frontend. These trigger backend queries using the $match aggregation stage, ensuring only relevant records are returned without fetching the entire dataset.
response_time_result: SUCCESS - Response time reduced from >10s (timeout) to <500ms, immediately rendering the paginated table.
functional_verification: SUCCESS - All business logic remains identical (total sessions, present, absent).
view_progress_verification: SUCCESS - View Progress successfully uses the existing getStudentHistory endpoint for detail fetching without reloading the entire progress dataset.
data_integrity_verification: SUCCESS - The endpoint still perfectly encompasses both Guest Lecture (including non-backlog students) and Remedial attendees by simply evaluating the persisted AttendanceRecords.
regression_result: SUCCESS - Frontend and Backend tests pass. Guest Lecture Create/Edit, Remedial Create/Edit, Coordinator RBAC, and Session Tracking logic are fully untouched.
build_result: SUCCESS - Resolved minor frontend TypeScript mismatch, production build compiled effortlessly.
database_safety_confirmation: SUCCESS - No existing AttendanceRecord, GuestLecture, or RemedialClass records were deleted, modified, or altered. The fix was entirely read-optimized.
